# buildbyalex.com

> Independent senior fullstack developer based in Warsaw, Poland, working remotely with clients across Poland and the EU. Builds production websites, online stores, AI agents, Telegram bots, mobile apps, process automation, and runs Google Ads. Direct, fast, business-aware. Languages: Russian (native), Ukrainian (native), English (B2+), Polish (B1, conversational).

## Identity

- Brand: buildbyalex
- Role: Independent senior fullstack developer (one-person operation, not an agency)
- Location: Warsaw, Poland. Works remotely with all of Poland and the EU: Kraków, Wrocław, Gdańsk, Poznań, Łódź, Katowice, Szczecin, Lublin, Bydgoszcz.
- Contact: info@buildbyalex.com · https://t.me/sumotry
- Website: https://buildbyalex.com
- Working hours: EU / US-friendly. Reply within hours, usually same day.

## Services, prices and delivery times

Prices are starting prices in EUR, fixed in a written quote before work begins. Every project includes a contract, a written launch date and 30 days of edits after launch.

### Websites - from €390
https://buildbyalex.com/en/services/websites
Also searched as: website development, custom website design, web development services, landing page development, corporate website, website redesign, multilingual website.
Landing page from €390 (1-2 weeks), company website from €690 (2-4 weeks), online store from €1,090 (3-5 weeks), redesign and migration from €550 (2-3 weeks). Built on Next.js 15 / React 19 / TypeScript / Tailwind. Multilingual (PL/EN/RU/UA) with localized URLs and hreflang. Schema.org, sitemap, IndexNow, OG generation, sub-1s LCP. CMS optional (Sanity, Notion, MDX).

Models: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini - provider-agnostic behind an abstraction layer, on top of RAG over the client's own documents. Integrations: HubSpot, Pipedrive, Bitrix24, Telegram Bot API, WhatsApp, Instagram DM, Slack, Google Sheets. Always with a human-in-the-loop dashboard. Data processed on EU servers, conversations excluded from model training. Article 50 of the EU AI Act (in force 2 August 2026) handled by default: the bot discloses that it is a machine. Running cost after launch is typically €20-60/month in API usage.

A fixed set of 40 buyer questions run through ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Copilot, with raw answers saved, competitors named and a concrete fix list. Also searched as: generative engine optimization, answer engine optimization, AI search optimization.

## Pricing rules

- Final price is fixed after a 30-minute discovery call. Written estimate within 24 hours.
- Edits after launch: €35/hour, 1-hour minimum. No forced monthly retainer.
- Contracts always in writing. Polish or English law.
- VAT EU invoicing available.
- Code, domain, hosting, ad accounts and store accounts are always registered in the client's name.

## Case studies (real client work)

### LegalWin (legalwin.pl)
- Industry: Immigration legal services, Warsaw
- Built: Multilingual Next.js 15 site (RU/PL/UA) with RAG AI consultant on GPT-4o
- Stack: Next.js 15, TypeScript, next-intl, RAG via pgvector, Telegram Bot API, Vercel
- Results:
  - Ranks in top-10 for 15+ commercial queries in PL ("karta pobytu Warszawa", "pobyt stały Polska")
  - AI consultant handles ~80% of first-touch client contacts
  - Displays a real 4.9★ rating from 312 clients

### VisionAir (visionair.biz.pl)
- Industry: Aerial cinematography (drone), Warsaw
- Built: Fast Next.js site with 7 SEO-optimized service verticals + instant Telegram lead pipeline
- Stack: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, next-intl (EN/PL/RU/UK), Upstash Redis (rate-limit), Telegram Bot API, IndexNow, Vercel
- Results:
  - Sub-1s LCP across all 7 service verticals
  - Leads reach the operator on Telegram in under 2 seconds
  - New pages indexed in hours, not days
  - Visitor-to-lead conversion 4.2% (up from 0.8% on the previous site)

### CRM Bot (under NDA, B2B sales automation)
- Industry: B2B sales automation
- Built: AI agent that replaced the first-touch sales manager
- Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Gemini 2.0 Flash with function calling, AmoCRM API v4, Firestore, Wappi (WhatsApp), Telegram Bot API
- Results:
  - Lead qualification reduced from ~40 minutes to ~8 minutes
  - 100% coverage of incoming leads - none go unanswered
  - Qualified-lead conversion up 31% from process stability

## How working with me differs from an agency

- You message me directly. No account managers, no junior developers under a senior's signature. The person you brief is the person writing the code.
- Decisions take minutes, not weeks.
- Fixed scope, fixed price, fixed launch date - written before the project starts.
- Weekly demos every Friday. Course can change at any time.
- 30 days of bug-fix support included in every project.

## Common questions and exact answers

- How much does a website cost? Landing page from €390, company website from €690, online store from €1,090. The quote is fixed before work starts and does not change mid-project.
- How much does a mobile app cost? MVP on iOS and Android from €1,800, full app with integrations from €4,200, larger product from €9,000. Publishing to both stores is included.
- How much does an AI chatbot cost? From €890 on the client's own knowledge base, from €1,490 wired into a CRM. Running cost after launch is typically €20-60/month in API usage.
- How much does a Telegram bot cost? Lead-intake bot from €190, AI bot with CRM from €390, Mini App with payments from €890.
- How much does process automation cost? One connection from €550, a multi-step flow from €1,090, a system of linked processes from €2,100.
- How long does a website take? Landing page 1-2 weeks, company site 2-4 weeks, online store 3-5 weeks. The launch date is in writing before kickoff.
- Native iOS or React Native? Cross-platform via React Native / Expo for most product cases. Native code only when truly needed (AR, heavy graphics, specialized hardware, real-time audio).
- Will the site rank on Google? Yes - that's the default, not an upsell. Technical SEO (schema, hreflang, Core Web Vitals, IndexNow on deploy) is part of every site.
- Edits after launch? €35/hour, 1-hour minimum, no forced retainer.
- Do you work only in Warsaw? No. Warsaw is the base for contracts and invoicing; the work is remote across Poland and the EU.
- Do you work in Polish? Yes - conversational Polish (B1), enough for meetings, contracts, day-to-day work. Fluent English (B2+). Native Russian and Ukrainian.
- Who owns the result? The client. Code, repository, domain, hosting, store accounts and ad accounts are all registered in the client's name and can be handed to any other developer.
